mechanism_claims.claim_text: Clavatustide A and B suppress proliferation of human hepatocellular carcinoma cell lines in a dose- and time-dependent phenotype assay; the paper reports HCC cell lines more sensitive than L02 cells by IC50/max-effect dose comparison.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is cellular cytotoxic/proliferation phenotype evidence, not antimicrobial activity and not a direct molecular mechanism assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: At 15 ug/mL for 48 h, clavatustide A and B increase the G1-phase fraction and reduce S phase in HepG2 cells, supporting G1 arrest/G1-S transition suppression as a cellular phenotype.
